description: This file defines TypeScript interfaces, constants, and utility functions related to MCP tools and server configurations used in the UI component. It includes definitions for teams, authentication types, transport mechanisms, input schemas, MCP tools, and server information relevant to the MCP system.

methods.name: handleTransport
methods.description: Returns the transport mechanism; defaults to SSE if undefined or null.

methods.name: handleAuth
methods.description: Returns the authentication type; defaults to 'none' if invalid or undefined.
